stem: A manufacturing company's external logistics partner needs to drop daily inventory files into AWS over SFTP, and the manufacturing company does not want to operate or patch its own FTP server.

choices.text: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server

rationale: AWS Transfer Family provides managed SFTP, FTPS, AS2, and FTP endpoints backed by S3 or EFS specifically for exchanging files with external partners who require one of those protocols, without standing up and patching an EC2-hosted FTP server. AWS DataSync is built for a bulk, one-time, or recurring transfer or migration job; it does not expose an ongoing SFTP endpoint for an outside partner to connect to. AWS Storage Gateway (its S3 File Gateway type) presents an NFS or SMB share for on-premises applications; it does not offer an SFTP endpoint for a partner either. Amazon FSx for Windows File Server is a managed native Windows file system reached over SMB for internal Windows-based applications, not an SFTP exchange point for an external partner.
